thread:
maria: FYI team: external penetration test confirmed for Mon 09:00 PT (vendor: IronGarrison). Scope: prod api, model-hosting, CI artifact store. Need concrete prereqs: RBAC snapshot, KMS temporary access, audit-export, and a retest booking plan. Can we split chores? :clipboard:
sam: I can take the RBAC snapshot + vuln triage tracker. Please list exact projects and service accounts in-scope so I can scope exports.
kevin: I'll handle KMS ephemeral bindings + IAM conditions. Quick question: artifact verification requires decrypt-only, right? No sign ops expected? @anita
anita: Correct — decrypt-only for artifact access. Also require evidence acceptance signature from legal. Retention policy: keep evidence for 120 days by default unless request says otherwise.
ryan: I'll own audit log export and bucket immutability. Plan: export Cloud Audit Logs to gs://pt-evidence-exports/1819000000/ and set a hold for 7 days. Will run pre-engagement snapshot 30m prior.
ops-bot: Temporary role request created: PT-1819000000. Approvers: @ryan, @kevin. Link: https://ops.internal/requests/1819000000 :white_check_mark:
sam: RBAC export command I'll run (example):

```
rbac-dump --projects=redwood-prod,redwood-staging --out=rbac-1819000000.ndjson
gsutil cp rbac-1819000000.ndjson gs://pt-evidence-exports/1819000000/
```

kevin: IAM snippet I plan to apply (will gate with condition window):

```
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
    - serviceAccount:pt-assessor@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  condition:
    title: "PT ephemeral"
    expression: "request.time >= timestamp('2026-06-01T16:00:00Z') && request.time <= timestamp('2026-06-01T18:00:00Z')"
```

anita: Make sure we avoid logging any prompt content or user-supplied embeddings. Redact fields upstream. Evidence manifest must include checksums (sha256) and a clear manifest.csv.
ryan: Audit export command I'll use:

```
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql '\nSELECT * FROM `project.audit_logs` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)' \n> audit-snapshot-1819000000.json
gsutil cp audit-snapshot-1819000000.json gs://pt-evidence-exports/1819000000/
```

maria: Proposed retest windows: Tue-Wed the week after, 1x 2-hour morning and 1x 2-hour afternoon slot. Sam — can you create a tracker board with owners + severity buckets?
sam: Yup. I'll create Trello (or GH project) and seed with initial categories: creds/exposure, authz, data-leak, telemetry. Owners assigned.
kevin: Will open a PR with the ephemeral role, a rollback plan, and short instructions for assessors. PR will include how to request access and the exact service account to use.
ops-bot: Dry-run invite created for Fri 10:30am PT. Channel: #eng-security. Invitees: maria, sam, kevin, ryan, anita.
ryan: One operational constraint: we must not apply IAM changes earlier than 15 minutes before the scheduled start to avoid lingering elevated access. Ops will enforce.
anita: Legal asks that we include an evidence receipt form and signer name in the manifest. I'll prepare a template and post it here.
maria: Good. Also add an abort condition: if error rate on public APIs > 2x baseline or auth failures spike, we immediately pause and notify execs. I'll add incident contact details to the runbook.
sam: Noted — I'll add the alert and the playbook entry to the tracker. Also attaching the list of in-scope service accounts now.
kevin: I'll add a lightweight middleware to capture request_id + route + latency (no prompt text) for 72h. It will be behind a feature flag and reverted after window. Patch will include tests and a timed rollback job.
ryan: After export I'll post checksums and how to verify. Please DO NOT modify any exported evidence files — we must preserve hashes.
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate into the pen-test runbook and send calendar invites. If urgent issues arise during the engagement, open the #release-war-room channel and page me. :mega:
